question: List the most commonly used Stellar Ecosystem Proposals (SEPs) for wallets and anchors with their numbers and purposes.

golden.answer: SEP-1: Stellar Info File (stellar.toml). SEP-6: programmatic deposit and withdrawal. SEP-10: web authentication (challenge, then JWT). SEP-12: KYC API. SEP-24: hosted interactive deposit and withdrawal. SEP-31: cross-border payments between anchors. SEP-38: Anchor RFQ quotes. Wallets also use SEP-7 (delegated-signing URI) and SEP-8 (regulated assets).
keyFacts: SEP-1 is the stellar.toml info file; SEP-10 is web authentication.
SEP-12 is the KYC API; SEP-24 is hosted deposit and withdrawal.
SEP-6 is programmatic deposit and withdrawal; SEP-31 is anchor-to-anchor payments.
SEP-38 is the Anchor RFQ quote API.
avoid: Do NOT pair a SEP number with the wrong standard, such as SEP-24 as KYC or SEP-31 as interactive deposit.
golden.notes: Lifecycle status is not required for this purpose-list question.
